Facing his home country adds a fascinating personal dimension to this crucial Group 1 [...] Italy enter this fixture in a period of honest rebuilding under Roberto Mancini, who has returned for a second stint at the helm following the Azzurri's failure to qualify for the 2026 World Cup.
